alex: seeing a short 502 spike for /v1/generate around 11:12 PDT, alert fired. can someone point me to the exact dashboards + a couple example traces/log queries? trying to collect evidence before I open a follow-up ticket :grimacing:

sre-bot: alert triggered: ingress-5xx-rate (service=api-gateway) at 2026-03-17T18:12:04Z — rate 0.78% over 1m > threshold 0.5% :rotating_light:

tara: alex — start with these: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/ingress-errors and https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/route-health (both have per-route breakdowns). look at the "proxy 502s by upstream" panel and the sample traces link on the ingress-errors dash.

jon: for quick log hits use Loki: `{namespace="prod", app="api-gateway"} |= "502" |= "\/v1\/generate"` then group by `upstream_host` and `request_id`. for traces, filter in APM on service=api-gateway and status_code=502 and timeframe 15m.

emily: if you need a single curl to reproduce headers we usually check `x-upstream` and `x-request-id`. curl example: ```curl -sI 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'x-debug=1'``` might show upstream timeout headers (e.g., `x-upstream-timeout`).

alex: thanks — do we have a suggested alert tuning? this looked like a very short burst (20–30s) but it noisified the channel.

jon: yeah, short bursts are noisy. two quick options: 1) change evaluation window to 5m avg (reduce burst noise), or 2) keep 1m but increase threshold to 1% and add a `min_n_requests` of 100 so tiny routes don't trigger. also add a debounce (quiet period) of 3m before reopen.

tara: proposal: update `infra/alerts/ingress_errors.yaml` to `for: 3m`, `threshold: 0.8%`, and `min_request_count: 200` for /v1/generate route. i can put up a PR after alex confirms evidence.

alex: i'll collect traces/log snippets and paste below, + the top upstream host. then please PR.

alex: snippet from Loki (trimmed): ```level=error msg="upstream response 502" upstream=nginx-upstream-7 request_id=abcd-1234 path=/v1/generate duration_ms=2160```

alex: APM sample: https://traces.redwood/trace/ab12cd34 showing upstream timeout on `model-proxy-3` at 18:11:59Z — span shows `connect timeout` and rtt spiked.

devex: FYI if you want quick reproducer, set `X-Force-Backend=slow-model` header in staging to hit the slow upstream (can help verify alert behaviour).

tara: ok great — alex, after you paste request_ids i'll open the PR and tag @oncall-sre for review. suggested PR title: "tune ingress 5xx alert: reduce burst noise for high-volume routes".

alex: pasted two request_ids: abcd-1234 and abcd-5678. both show same upstream `model-proxy-3`. i've attached the log lines in the ticket I'm about to create.

jon: once PR is up, also add a short note in the alert doc explaining tradeoff (sensitivity vs noise) and link to these traces. :memo:

tara: will do. thanks all — closing this thread once PR merged. :thumbsup:
